items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Oh she loved us. Oh she was for us, yes indeed. We were a foursome. Talk about having fun together. And when they'd come to New York we'd hang out together.

ctx.x: Yes well you know when you look back on things you can see what was right and what was wrong. But I mean at the time, now who was Louis married to then?
Well what influence would she have had?
